verdict.rationale: Claude is operated by natural language across surfaces: the docs cite chat on web, desktop and mobile, a terminal agent that writes, reviews and ships code, and web search, file creation and code execution. Hands-on community reports confirm conversational and agentic use, such as one-shot fixing a UI bug. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how natural-language commands drive product actions (the docs are one-line marketing claims), and documentation of any limits on which actions can be invoked by natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
